prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page for each.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dash camera data, repair estimates, appraisal reports, adjuster notes, and all communications with your insured or any third party. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
